_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: February 23, 2027, with Premium Edition early access from February 18. The date and cast come from Xbox Wire (news.xbox.com, 2026-06-07, Xbox Games Showcase 2026). The official @fable account repeated the date on X on November 12, 2026. Platforms are Xbox Series X|S, PC and PS5. Names from Xbox Wire: Isabel, Hero of Wraithmarsh (Hayley Atwell); the Hero of Briar Hill (Lily Nichol / Ukweli Roach); Humphry (Matt King); Arden the Cobbler; Dave the Giant (Richard Ayoade); Jenny and Jacob, the heirs to Bloodstone; Connor; Grandma Samira; Nigel the Sheriff of Silverbrook; Bowerstone; the Heroes' Guild; Balverines, Hobbes and trolls. 'Humphry the Golden' comes from coverage of the same reveal. The Jack of Blades return (a post-credits tease in the showcase trailer) is reported by several outlets and by Wikipedia. Weak words: Fable and #Fable are ordinary words (not aliases). Isabel, Humphry, Jenny, Jacob, Connor, Nigel, Samira and Arden are first names (Arden is also a forest). Albion, Briar Hill and Silverbrook are real places or clubs. Bloodstone is a gemstone. Hobbes is a surname and part of 'Calvin and Hobbes'. Heroes' Guild is a generic phrase. Every actor is weak. Left out because only one source names them: Hollow Folk, the Lantern Keeper and Butterfield Market. 'Fable 4' is a fan name, not official, but fans post it, so it is in aliases. Accounts: fable (the official game account) and WeArePlayground (the developer, linked from the @fable bio). Xbox is left out because it posts about all Xbox games.
name: Fable
